listening.title: A follow-up call with a client after the first month

lines.speaker: Mai (Customer Success Executive)
lines.text: Hello Mr. Duy. I am calling to check how your team is using the system.

lines.speaker: Duy (Client, IT Manager)
lines.text: Hello Mai. In general it is fine, but some staff are still confused.

lines.speaker: Mai (Customer Success Executive)
lines.text: I see. Would a refresher training session next week help your new staff?

lines.speaker: Duy (Client, IT Manager)
lines.text: Yes, that would be useful. We hired four people after the onboarding call.

lines.speaker: Mai (Customer Success Executive)
lines.text: No problem. I will also send the short video guides again by email.

lines.speaker: Duy (Client, IT Manager)
lines.text: Thank you. One more thing: our tickets sometimes wait a whole day.

lines.speaker: Mai (Customer Success Executive)
lines.text: I am sorry about that. Your plan includes dedicated support with a four-hour response time.

lines.speaker: Duy (Client, IT Manager)
lines.text: Good to know. Please make sure the support team is aware of that.

lines.speaker: Mai (Customer Success Executive)
lines.text: I will. Being proactive matters to us because customer satisfaction is our main goal.

lines.speaker: Duy (Client, IT Manager)
lines.text: I appreciate it. We will decide about the renewal at the end of the quarter.
